fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestNodePages renders a capability, a decision with a quote, a decision with wording and question, a question, a source and an intent, each with its groups of links and history; an unknown ref answers 404 with a page naming the ref.
fields.statement: Every model node has a page at /p/<project>/nodes/<ref>, as in pages/model-page.html: its kind and statement; for a decision, the owner's quote shown as 'In your words' with the question it answered, or the agent's wording marked as picked by the owner; what it decided or links to, grouped; where it came from (sources and change sets); and its history.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestLinksResolve crawls Home, the roadmap, a change set page, a run page and a node page of a two-project fixture root and gets 200 for every internal link.
fields.statement: Every link the web UI renders inside a project resolves to a page that exists in that project.
